beats.title: The swarm of red gnats is driven back into the forest
beats.summary: At the forest's edge, Thrin, Ephanna, Karsemine, and Caelynn battle the swarm of red gnats. Thrin's arrows and Ephanna's Eldritch Blasts thin the swarm; Karsemine lands four hits and uses Zephyr Strike; Caelynn escapes the swarm and casts Thunderwave, splitting it and pushing it back. The swarm gives up and returns to the forest, and the team decides to report their findings.
